name: plans
description: Query and archive duya execution plans from the global plans directory (~/.duya/projects/<projectId>/plans): list active plans, search across projects, and move finished plans to completed.

interface.shortDescription: Query and archive duya execution plans
interface.longDescription: Built-in tools for working with duya execution plans stored under (~/.duya/projects/<projectId>/plans/): plan_status lists a project's active plans, plan_search finds plans across projects by keyword, and plan_complete archives a finished plan. Plan creation and content editing stay with the ordinary file tools. These are built-in tools in the duya agent, not MCP servers.
